import re
import sys

values = {}
text = sys.stdin.read()

assignment_pattern = re.compile(r'\b([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*<-\s*([^;]+)')
increment_pattern = re.compile(
    r'\(\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*100'
)

for match in assignment_pattern.finditer(text):
    name, rhs = match.group(1), match.group(2).strip()

    if rhs.isdigit():
        values[name] = int(rhs)
    else:
        increment = increment_pattern.fullmatch(rhs)
        variable, amount = increment.groups()
        values[name] = (values[variable] + int(amount)) % 100

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in
                ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")) + ";")
